items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: I can't recall offhand that he, uh, I know he spoke about all those people... I don't remember that he said anything, uh, you know, of particular importance about them

ctx.x: I'm going to put on some of these, uh, tapes that were made at the Stuyvesant, uh, one night during that, uh, 1947, say, about November, or October, December, long in the, uh, late fall of 1947. You can see if you have any, uh, memories of those, uh, it's going backwards, I guess. Do you have anything you can say for a minute, but I'll read about this?
While we're speaking about, uh, him and Noon, it also brings the, uh, recollections of, uh, Freddie Kepard, uh, did Bunk ever speak about Freddie?

Uh, I can't recall offhand that he, uh, I know he spoke about all those people, because we were constantly asking him questions about every name that we knew of in New Orleans, and, and, uh, uh, I'm sure he couldn't be evasive all the time, and, uh, change the subject all the time. I know there are times when, uh, when he would talk, you know, uh, about these people, and, uh, but I don't remember that he said anything, uh, you know, of particular importance about them, aside from saying that, yeah, they were fine…
